verdict.rationale: Airwallex Billing documents invoicing that generates invoices and digital payment links accepting 160+ local payment methods, including one-time and recurring invoices, so invoices can be sent and paid online. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic payment reminders. Missing for 10: automatic invoice reminders/dunning, explicit hosted invoice page documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: Generate invoices and digital payment links with over 160+ local payment methods
You can issue invoices in two ways with Airwallex Billing: One-time invoices ... Recurring invoices
Airwallex Billing layers subscriptions, invoicing, and hosted/embedded billing checkout on top of payments acceptance
